info.description: Directory endpoints exposed by the gateway. Public routes need no credentials; every other route needs a bearer session and the permission named in x-required-permissions. Routes marked x-app-scope additionally require the X-OT-AppScope header.
info.title: Optimistic Tanuki Directory API

post.description: townId is optional; dryRun defaults to true. A real run (dryRun false) needs a reason. One job runs at a time (409 detail job_running). Poll GET jobs/{id}; job state is in memory and does not survive a Directory restart.

get.summary: Read a maintenance job status and counts

get.description: Only state=suspended is supported. Newest suspension first, keyset-paged with limit (1-100) and cursor; total counts every match.

post.description: Runs the same revalidation the sweep uses and returns the resulting state. 503 when the source stage is not configured.
post.summary: Revalidate one reviewed binding against its source

post.description: Same rules as install with activate set; an optional reason is recorded in the audit.
post.summary: Activate an installed taxonomy mapping version

post.description: Needs a reason. Refused with 409 detail unmapped_policy_excludes when it is the active version and its unmappedPolicy would exclude listings.

get.summary: Read whether a town boundary is locked

post.description: Needs a reason and a verified current boundary. 409 detail already_locked or no_verified_boundary. Recovery keeps the lock.
post.summary: Lock the boundary a town serves now

post.description: Needs a reason. 409 detail not_locked when there is no lock. Recovery does not recreate a lock that was removed.
post.summary: Unlock a town boundary and return it to boundary review
